slot_capacity.description: The minimum number of slots available for this reservation.
slot_capacity.rationale: Slot capacity needs to be set to a value greater than 0 so the reservation is valid and has a baseline capacity.

name.description: The name of the reservation. This must only contain letters, numbers, or dashes.

ignore_idle_slots.description: If set to true, this reservation will only use its own slots (it won’t take idle slots from other reservations).
ignore_idle_slots.rationale: We set ignore_idle_slots to true so this reservation doesn’t use spare slots from other reservations, which helps keep things separated and controlled.

concurrency.description: The maximum number of queries that can run at the same time in this reservation.
concurrency.rationale: Concurrency needs to stay within the approved range to prevent too many queries running at once.

edition.description: The edition type for the reservation (STANDARD, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_PLUS).
edition.rationale: Edition must be set to an approved value to match the required BigQuery reservation standard.

autoscale.description: Settings for auto scaling. This lets BigQuery increase slots when needed.

current_slots.description: (Output) The number of extra slots added when autoscale happens.

max_slots.description: The maximum number of slots autoscale can add.
max_slots.rationale: Max slots must stay within the approved limit so autoscaling doesn’t go too high.

secondary_location.description: The secondary location used for disaster recovery (if enabled).

location.description: The location/region where the reservation is created.
location.rationale: Location must be set to an approved region to meet data residency and compliance requirements.

project.description: If not provided, the provider project is used.
